summaries.en: US President Donald Trump shared a video of a bombed major bridge near Tehran, warning of subsequent attacks on power plants to pressure Iran into a ceasefire, even as Iranian media reported civilian casualties.
summaries.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普分享了德黑兰附近一座主要桥梁被轰炸的视频，并警告称如果伊朗不接受停火，将进一步袭击发电厂以施压，尽管伊朗媒体报道了平民伤亡。
